poses.name: master
poses.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE original full-body desktop game pet sprite: Chibi Knight, a cute but competent girl 2.5 heads tall, big head small body. Crimson/maroon plate armor over steel-grey underlayer, simple brass trim, small round shield with red field in her left hand (image right), short steel sword in her right hand (image left). Dark brown short bob hair. Visible face, large brown eyes with clear eyelashes, tiny mouth, blush. Rounded steel helm with raised visor and cheek guards and curved red feather plume; no horns, no antennae. Small maroon cape. Front three-quarter view facing slightly right, relaxed standing idle, feet level. Clean modern chibi game pixel-art-adjacent sprite, sharp consistent dark outline, flat 2-3 tone cel shading per material, no gradients, texture or noise, no soft lighting. Original generic character, no blonde, no blue dress, no golden sword, no franchise likeness. Whole character centered, all plume/sword/feet inside frame with generous transparent margins. Character silhouette about 140 wide by 190 tall in proportion; designed to downscale to a 192x208 cell with about 1px dark outlines. ONE character only, no lettering, no ground, no cast shadow, no plate, fully transparent background. This is the master IDLE pose for a consistent animation pack.

Same proportions and scale, clean dark outline and flat 2-3 tone cel shading; simplify away gradients. Entire character with generous transparent margin, no crop, no ground shadow, no text, fully transparent background. Single character only.
